messages:
elaine: dropped new routing-editor frames in Figma: /figma/routing/editor-v3. Looking for quick design + copy sanity checks before sprint demo.
pranav: skimmed it. overall clean. two problems: priority ordering still relies on invisible numbers and users keep asking "which rule runs first". can we show an explicit 'Evaluated first' label on hover?
toni: also noticed the inline rule validation is noisy. current toast reads: 'Rule invalid'. prefer more precise: 'Missing parameter: `request.user.agent` in condition #2' with a one-click 'Add sample value' quick action.
kevin: keyboard nav: when tabbing into a rule row, focus jumps to the first input and you can't move the whole row. recommend a row-level focusable element that exposes move actions (move up, move down, duplicate). ARIA suggestion: use role="listitem" + aria-posinset/aria-setsize to indicate ordering.
pranav: preview simulator feedback: great feature. want a compact per-request trace that shows rule matching order. idea: show a tiny vertical timeline with dots: evaluated, matched, fallback. hover shows reason.
elaine: copy tweak: change 'Fallback to compatible variant' -> 'Fallback to lower-capacity model' or 'Fallback to secondary model (lower capacity)'. PM prefers second for clarity.
toni: accessibility: contrast issue with muted badge text (0.9em). devops-bot: running contrast checker.
devops-bot: Contrast check result: muted-badge text ratio 3.6:1 (warning for small text), draggable handle focus outline missing.
kevin: when a new rule is inserted we currently append it. product wants new rules to appear above the selected rule, and a setting in the editor prefs to set default insert position (top/bottom). show a small hint: 'New rules added above the selected rule' for clarity.
pranav: validation UX: aggregate errors in a top banner with counts (errors / warnings). clicking the banner should jump to the offending rule and highlight the exact clause. support 'autofix' where possible (e.g., add missing header placeholder).
elaine: simulation batch idea: upload a CSV of example requests, run them through the engine, then show a sortable table: request-id, matched-rule, latency-estimate, fallback-used. clicking a row opens the trace.
toni: mobile: conditions wrap poorly. propose pillified conditions with ellipsis and a 'Show full' modal. improves readability on small screens.
kevin: UX microcopy: change 'Priority' label to 'Priority (higher runs first)' to reduce confusion.
pranav: rename the 'Enabled' toggle to 'Active' to avoid confusion with feature flags.
elaine: action items: @pranav write ARIA + keyboard spec, @toni implement validation banner + autofix buttons, @kevin add insert-above behavior and microcopy updates, I'll wire up the preview trace UI and CSV batch runner.
pranav: also, add unit tests in the editor-e2e suite for keyboard reorder and autofocus behavior.
devops-bot: Reminder: staging deploy of editor-v3 scheduled Wed 09:15 PT.
elaine: awesome, will post updated frames and a short explainer video before the deploy. ping me for pairing on the a11y pass.
